newsitem.title: UK: Low output prices encouraging - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Low output prices encouraging - Treasury.

text.p: British Treasury minister Angela Knight said in a statement that a good set of producer price numbers were an excellent base for falls in the wider measure of inflation, the retail prices index.
"The figures...are an excellent base for falls in inflation in the high street," the Treasury statement said.
UK SEPT OUTPUT PRICES +0.4% MM, +2.2% YY, INPUT PRICES S/A +0.3% MM, -2.9% YY
UK SEPT S/A OUTPUT PRICES EX-FOOD,DRINK,TOBACCO,PETROL +0.1% MM, +0.9% YY
